subtitle: Ann Jones, a visitor
passage: I was looking at the Monalisa, and someone threw a cake at the painting.
I turned around and saw an old man.
He was standing in front of a wheelchair.
I’m about 170 cm tall, and he was a little taller than me.
passage_ko: (방문객 Ann Jones) 저는 모나리자를 보고 있었는데, 누군가가 그 그림에 케이크를 던졌어요.
저는 키가 약 170cm인데, 그는 저보다 조금 더 컸어요.
